articles.title: Anthropic is committing 5% of its shares to a ‘Public Benefit Fund’
articles.summary:
The new Anthropic Public Benefit Fund will be a wholly owned LLC, which the company says will give it “flexibility.” It offered little information about how it would use the money, other than saying it wouldn’t fund lobbying or political donations. It offered limited examples of what it might do:
> … we might explore large donations to traditional nonprofits or direct distributions to specific populations.
> One example is labor market impacts. AI may generate enormous economic value, but it could also cause instability for many workers. Anthropic has already committed $200 million to studying and addressing this issue, but given the pace of AI progress, bolder approaches may be needed.
